text:
maria: Morning — quick async checkin for SDKs / quickstarts / sampleapps.

What I did: updated the Node quickstart README to clarify the env var steps, moved the example app to use the new samplekit entrypoint, and fixed a docs link. Opened PR #452.
Blockers: mac M1 native wheel build failing in sampleapp CI (error: 'ld: symbol(s) not found for architecture arm64').
Today: spike a CI fix and land a tiny docs patch.

alex: Thanks — can you paste the failing log snippet? I can try the m1 build locally.

maria: Pasted above in the PR comment, but here's the minimal failing cmd output:
```
./setup_native.sh --build
...
ld: symbol(s) not found for architecture arm64
clang: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)
```

sam: I saw that earlier — I pushed a tentative change to the Dockerfile (use musl fallback). It helped on CI for x86 but not arm64. Might be a native dependency expecting x86 binary.

jia: For the docs side, I reviewed the quickstart wording. Small nit: call out `REDWOOD_API_KEY` instead of generic "API_KEY" so new users know the exact var. Also suggest a sample curl + node snippet.

maria: Good call @jia — updated the README to use REDWOOD_API_KEY and added a curl + node example.

alex: If @maria wants, I can pair on the build repro after lunch. Also pinging @docbot to run a docs link-check.

docbot: link-checker: queued run for 2105012350, will post results in thread when done.

sam: Minor ask — can someone review my PR that swaps the sample app to the new `samplekit` layout? It's blocking a couple onboarding templates. PR #449.

jia: Reviewing now, should have comments in ~30m.

maria: Quick question: should the quickstart keep the ipynb sample or move it to samples/interactive? I think move out of main quickstart to keep it minimal.

alex: I agree — main quickstart = minimal, put ipynb in samples/interactive with a pointer.

maria: Cool will make that change in the docs patch.

docbot: link-checker: completed. 2 warnings (relative image paths), 0 errors. See comment on PR #452.

maria: Thanks @docbot — will fix image paths.

alex: Summary/todo for today: maria: CI repro + fix, image paths, land docs patch. sam: follow up on Dockerfile + PR #449. jia: finish review. I'll pair on mac repro if needed.

maria: 👍 tagging the thread for later — will update when PRs merge.

sam: thanks — ping if you want another set of eyes on CI logs.

jia: done with review comments, a couple tiny wording requests.

maria: closing loop for now, will post status when builds pass. :thumbsup:
